script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Your ruling planet Neptune is forming a powerful trine with Mercury in your 1st House of Self, amplifying your intuition and communication like never before. In love, Venus is activating your 7th House of Partnerships, so if you're single, someone unexpected will reach out with genuine depth and emotional honesty — be open. If taken, a heartfelt conversation could deepen your bond. For career and money, Jupiter is sextile your 10th House of Career, bringing a financial opportunity through a creative project or freelance work. One thing to avoid: don't overcommit to someone else's drama today — protect your energy. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what's coming this week.
